prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Correct the walking action of the SAME right-facing tactical-map heavy guardian in Image1, using Image2 for the original two leg phases. Blue-white matte armor, solid gray-brown hair, navy contour, natural brown/steel lance, white diamond on blue rectangular shield. Keep exact identity and tactical chibi proportions. IMPORTANT the shield is strapped to the near-side left forearm, so the ENTIRE arm and shield must swing together about the shoulder. It must never stay fixed while its forearm swings away. Keep the full shield face visible to camera.
Make FOUR separate production rig assets in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW with generous transparent gutters, one asset per column, same scale between assets, no labels or extra figures. Column1: ONE STATIC UPPER-BODY CORE: right-facing head, fixed torso, shoulders, both shoulder pauldrons, belt, far-side armored right arm holding the same single long lance pointed diagonally lower-right as Image1. No legs or skirt below the belt. OMIT the near-side left arm and shield entirely below its shoulder pauldron, leaving a socket for a separate animation layer. Keep the lance and far-side arm COMPLETE. Column2: ONE HIP/SKIRT/TWO-LEG ASSEMBLY for Image1's FIRST walking pose: blue skirt flaps and both armored legs from waist attachment through complete feet, wide stride with one foot forward-right and other back-left, same pose as first reference. NO head, torso, arms, spear or shield. Column3: ONE HIP/SKIRT/TWO-LEG ASSEMBLY for Image1's SECOND walking pose: folded marching leg phase with feet closer together and alternate knee bent, exactly like second reference and second native source pose; NO head, torso, arms, spear or shield. Keep same waist width and attachment position as column2. Column4: ONE COMPLETE ATTACHED ARM-AND-SHIELD ASSEMBLY: near-side left upper arm from shoulder socket to bent elbow and forearm, gauntlet and ONE blue rectangular shield strapped to that forearm, white rim and white diamond. Show this assembly hanging slightly backward-left as seen on the right-facing character, shield front visible. The short upper-arm socket should emerge from the upper-right of this assembly so it can pivot below the fixed pauldron. Arm and shield are a single connected rigid piece and will be swung forward/back together. No extra shoulder armor larger than in reference. These four are deliberate separate 2D animation layers; the one core prevents body bobbing. Clear crisp low-color pixel art, no shiny hair or cloth, no background, ground, glow, shadows, text, duplicate weapons or loose particles. Exactly one upper body with lance, two lower-body leg phases, one attached shield-arm assembly.
